study: CP-IF24 / P2-18 equal visible native input
sequence: Re-execute unchanged P2-17 T3/T5, freeze local observer delivery counts and evaluate old primary metrics before implementing A3. A2 only reads count exports, public goals, and original source indices. A4 is matched by counts and independent from visual triggers. Holdout selected by public provenance before A3 and reviewed after A3 code lock, before its test predictions.
visible_scope: One native complete PNG image content block actually consumed by an offline observer-interface receiver equals one item. Repeated sends count on each delivery. Internal reads, metadata, scoped debug crops and cache reads without delivery do not count. No SDK calls or model interpretation scored.
text_scope: Identical public goal, ordinal/source PTS/time base/source-frame/seconds layout, prior timestamp and neutral gap mapping. No object, geometry, role, confidence or algorithm labels exposed in the observer prompt. Exact local metadata token count uses the existing CLIP tokenizer without truncation as a clearly labeled proxy, with UTF-8 bytes also reported.
public_range: Same original source SHA and stream [start,end) for all arms. Transport page size 16, no total frame or window limit. Raw packets can use any in-range unique source frames.
uniform: N=0 empty; N=1 time midpoint; N>=2 evenly spaced time targets including first/last eligible PTS. Choose nearest PTS without replacement using monotonic feasible ordinal ranges and earlier frame on equal distance. Order is chronological. Clamp at eligible unique source-frame count and report saturation/extra repeated items if necessary.
coverage: Use existing D6 endpoints and consecutive gap midpoints as initial candidates. At matched n, continue via largest normalized uncovered time interval and choose closest still-unread source PTS to its center. D6 is ordinary coverage, never a change trigger. Separately replay T0's actual source-window route on stationary and latent-pulse controls to test coverage with its own natural n.
source_layer: Primary A2 uses the complete accessible original range. Also materialize full visual streams for a descriptive catalog-only layer, pairing the subsequence of actually visible catalog members with the same number of eligible M7 frames, for every goal before classifying reference membership. The source-layer diagnostic does not imply a separate change predictor ran with raw reread disabled.
reference: E0 only. Existing P2-17 sealed roles and controls carry over unchanged; positive windows are scope-limited. Record role support and oracle first-completion ordinal separately from completeness. Never use role scores to stop a formal route. No claim about physical causation, identity or absence.
